name: Word-by-Word Headline Reveal
use: Section headlines rise word by word from line masks on scroll; kicker and body fade up after.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (unminified) because of the exact-innerHTML restore, aria-label bookkeeping, link-underline fix and per-marker overrides. Uses CSS keyframes (fill both) instead of transitions: transitions raced at page load in Chrome and occasionally skipped the hidden state. Chrome quirk handled: removing a CSSOM-written style attribute without reading it first leaves style="".
